title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p19p: Python EDHOC transcript_2 diverges from RFC 9528 (breaks interop)
description: The Rust edhoc.rs fix correctly updates `transcript_2` to use `encode_bstr(G_Y) || encode_bstr(H(message_1))` per RFC 9528 Section 3.2. However, the Python EDHOC simulator at `python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py:389` and `:598` still computes `th_2_input = g_y + h_msg1` (raw concatenation, no CBOR bstr encoding). This breaks interop between Rust and Python — they produce different TH_2 values for the same inputs. All implementations MUST produce identical output per project requirements (LICHEN-plan.md). Fix: apply the same `encode_bstr` wrapping in Python to match the Rust code and RFC 9528.
